notes:
CONVENTIONS. An alteration year in Findlay 1887 is used as change_year, and both spans include that year. For an undated change, earliest is the year of the last witness showing the old light (report1880 → 1880; F1879 → 1879) and latest is the first year showing the new one (Edwards → 1884; F1887 → 1887). Both spans cover the whole window. Edwards is corrected to March 1884, so where Edwards still shows the old light and F1887 dates the change 1884 (South Sand Head, Happisburgh, Burnham), the change came after March 1884. Where Edwards already shows the new light, only Jan-Mar 1884 nights are really in doubt; trim those spans if you want. Sector-only changes (Coquet, Souter, Orfordness, Usk green sector, Nash red sector) are not counted as changes. Edwards was used as the state text where it is clearer than Findlay (Flamborough, Beachy Head, Point of Ayre IOM, Burnham's old state, Inner Farne's old state, Casquets, Hanois), and report1880 for Caernarfon Bay and Point of Ayr (Flints).

SUMMARY. 36 changed (Owers, St Agnes, North Stack and Tees are low confidence); 71 unchanged.
